about: Family B of the seeded test: one wrong 'met' verdict for each of the 40 v3 trap cells, written the way the split arm answers. resume_fact keeps to the resume's own words and figures, and every quote is copied from the resume; the wrong conclusion sits in the comparison, which is not checked. Written before the seeded test was run.
